source: Traced by hand and by color from USGS NAIP aerial photos (public domain), to fill in what OpenStreetMap doesn't have yet.

unsure.all: Hole order worked out from the photo, the map's unnumbered tees and greens, and the card's yardages; no hole map was used, so the numbering could be off.
unsure.1: Tee placed at the tee pads by the range west of the clubhouse; the hole traces about 460 yd against the card's 515, so the real back tee may be elsewhere.
unsure.4: Back tee not clearly visible; placed at the west end of the fairway north of the 3rd green.
unsure.6: Tee placed on the long tee strip west of the 5th green; green is an unmapped green by the creek north of the road.
unsure.7: Par-3 tee not visible; placed east of the creek where a bridge leads from the 6th green.
unsure.18: Shares a wide corridor with the 10th (played the other way); 18 traces about 420 yd against the card's 464.
